author: Leila Gharani
description:
Excel's new interactive canvas builds Excel dashboards with filters, sliders and a play button. 
👉 Copilot course insider pre-sale: https://www.xelplus.com/course/copilot/?utm_source=yt-video&utm_medium=vid-description&utm_campaign=copilot&utm_content=copilot-interactive-canvas


With Excel's new interactive canvas skill powered by Copilot in Excel, I describe the report I want, and Copilot builds it on its own sheet, connected to my Excel data. First, a travel expense report with KPI cards, charts, filters and commentary that updates. Then I make it interactive: click a bar to cross-filter, add a slider for a minimum amount, and click a number to drill into the details. Change the data and the report updates. No refresh needed.

Then I combine four sheets into a project status report for the steering committee, with a Gantt chart, RAG status, risk matrix and budget versus actual. A play button replays how the project unfolded. And to finish, a race chart of my top 10 customers.

title: 3 Excel Dashboards You Won't Believe Are Possible
